written: 2026-10-29, after claude_genfill_v1_20261027 FAILED, before any v1.1 output was produced or looked at
author: Claude (Cowork session); approved by Ahmed ('yes go')
what_changes: Inference only. Same LoRA (rudra_genfill.safetensors, sha256 9fff7eb8492ae62619a126d302d9c940403b2e4aa03e02daf79d98142008238a), same base, same steps/seed/windows. The model still sees the dilated highlight region (tau_high 250, dilate 4, EMA 0.7) as context; the fill is BLENDED only where max SDR code >= 255 (fully clipped), with no feather. Shadows off by default (tau_low -1).
why: Post-hoc analysis of the v1 evaluation (frame 0 of all 56 clips): at code 255 the fill lowered |dlog2| from 0.733 to 0.639 stops (better in 54 % of clips); at codes 250-254 and 1-4, where the exact inverse is within ~0.06-0.13 stop, it made them worse. This analysis used the v1 evaluation scenes, so v1.1 is evaluated on DIFFERENT scenes.

evaluation.scenes: Poly Haven: the shuffled held-scene list (seed 20261029) entries 24-47, none of which v1 evaluated; FXTD: fresh grade set v2 scenes 8-17 (sorted), none of which v1 evaluated
evaluation.clips: each Poly Haven scene: one highlight clip and one shadow clip; each FXTD scene: one highlight clip; 33 frames, 512x288, steps 30, seed 0, window 33, overlap 8; exposure: the first offset (half stops from +1 up for a highlight clip, from -2 down for a shadow clip) giving >= 0.5 % of frame 0 at code 255 (highlight) or <= 4 (shadow)
evaluation.master: the exact (analytic) inverse of the 8-bit ACES 2.0 SDR codes

gates.R: rint(255*view(filled)) == rint(255*view(master)) on every pixel of every frame
gates.H: on the fully clipped pixels (max code 255): mean |log2 Y_filled - log2 Y_truth| - same for the master < 0, with the 95 % bootstrap CI over clips excluding 0; and the mean PU21 error (Y*203 nits) at -3 EV and at -6 EV lower than the master's
gates.S: on the shadow pixels (max code <= 4) at +3 EV: the relative change of the mean code error, CI upper bound <= +2 %
gates.T: mean flicker excess of the region over the truth <= 0.02 EV
gates.also_reported: v1's dilated-region metrics (prefix v1region_), not gated

decision_rule: PASS on every gate: the AI fill may be offered (still labelled experimental, still off by default) in the app and Radiance Studio. FAIL: no promotion; next is a v2 retrain (loss on code-255/0 pixels only, more FXTD footage).
